item.title: Emotions Grow Unhealthy if not Observed
item.description: 👹 Emotions can grow to be overwhelming. They do that mostly when you’re not paying attention to them.

item.title: The 7 C's of the Authentic Self
item.description: The state of open-hearted ♥️ authentic self is characterized by the 7 C’s : clear, calm, compassionate, curious, connected, confident, and courageous.
